d:
presents the soul-stirring devotional video song 'Allaah' from the Telugu film 'Sri Ramadasu', starring Akkineni Nageswara Rao, Nagarjuna, and Sneha. Composed by the renowned duo M.M. Keeravani and sung by the talented Shankar Mahadevan, Vijay Yesudas captures the essence of devotion and showcases the divine love for Allah.
Enjoy and stay connected with us!!
Song Name : Allah
Music : M.M.Keeravani
Lyrics : Veda vyas
Singers : Shankar Mahadevan, Vijay Yesudas
Movie Name : Sri Ramadasu
Banner : Aditya Productions
